CLM-MAT-0160.statement: The thermodynamic Grüneisen parameter of silicon at 300 K computed via linear response with NequIP-OAM-M is 0.693.

extra_quotes: Here we show that the dynamical matrix of a message-passing potential can be obtained exactly in the primitive cell, at any wave vector, as the linear response of the forces to a displacement modulated by a Bloch phase, in the spirit of density-functional perturbation theory.
If, on the other hand, the dynamical matrix is calculated directly at many wave vectors, the cost is proportional to their number, and a dense mesh is expensive.
